title: Inhaled isoflurane for SEdation of invasively ventilated PaTIents with cardiogenic shock on extracOrporeal membrane oxygeNation (INSEPTION)
official: Inhaled isoflurane for SEdation of invasively ventilated PaTIents with cardiogenic shock on extracOrporeal membrane oxygeNation (INSEPTION)
summary: Main objective: To assess in cardiogenic shock patients on VA-ECMO the efficacy of inhaled isoflurane via the anesthetic conserving device, on a composite outcome of mortality and the number of ventilator-free days at day 28 following ECMO onset.
conditions: Adult patients with severe cardiogenic shock on venoarterial ECMO support for less than 24 hours.

interventions.name: CEDACONDA 100 % V/V, liquide pour inhalation par vapeur

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Cardiogenic shock on VA ECMO support for less than 24 hours
2. Patients on invasive mechanical ventilation receiving propofol and/or midazolam at the time of randomization
3. Invasive mechanical ventilation for less than 48 hours
4. Expected invasive ventilation and sedation for at least 24h, with a prescribed Richmond agitation scale target within the range of -1 to - 4
5. Social security registration (AME excluded)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Age <18 and >75
2. Suspected or proven intracranial hypertension
3. Corrected QT interval > 450ms or with a known or suspected genetic predisposition to malignant hyperthermia
4. Chronic liver disease defined as a Child-Pugh score of 12-15
5. Patients ventilated with a tidal volume < 4ml/kg predicted body weight
6. Participation in another interventional study or being in the exclusion period at the end of a previous study.
7. Contraindication or allergies to isoflurane, propofol, midazolam or other halogenated anaesthetics
8. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
9. Initiation of ECMO >24 hours
10. Initiation of mechanical ventilation >48 hours
11. Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation >20 minutes before randomization
12. Patient moribund on the day of randomization, SAPS II >90
